transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net TV technical support, my name is Bradley. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Bradley, my name is Leo Sterling. Ever since the software update on our S-Net TV box, the optical digital audio output to our Sonos soundbar is out of sync with the picture by two full seconds!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good afternoon Leo. I can inspect your set-top box digital audio settings. Before we check your sound configuration, could you confirm your full postal address and your account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 78 St John's Road, Bristol, BS8 2HR, and my security PIN is 9120. My TV box model is the 4K Pro Box with serial number SN-TV-44018.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Leo, that confirms your account details. Is the audio delay occurring across all channels or only live sports broadcasts?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It happens on every live channel, Netflix, and recorded shows: people's lips move, and two seconds later the words come out of the soundbar!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could I place you on hold for two minutes while I query your set-top box HDMI handshakes and audio driver telemetry?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Leo. The audio telemetry shows Dolby Digital Plus bitstream encoding enabled over the optical TOSLINK interface.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Have you found why the picture and sound are completely misaligned?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Dolby Digital Plus processing introduces buffering latencies when decoded by external third-party soundbars.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It worked with zero delay for eighteen months until your software patch updated overnight!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Well if you had actually bought an approved S-Net integrated soundbar instead of connecting third-party Sonos equipment, you wouldn't experience decoding latency.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How dare you blame my premium Sonos sound system! Your software update broke the optical timing clock!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Frontline technicians do not write digital signal processing microcode for third-party audio peripherals.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Then transfer me to your senior audiovisual specialist who can roll back the firmware update!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Firmware rollbacks cannot be performed on individual customer premises equipment.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You broke my television audio and refuse to let me speak to anyone who can fix it!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously TOSLINK optical connections lack the bidirectional eARC lip-sync communication protocols present in HDMI 2.1.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I am on the optical cable because my television does not have eARC! What can I adjust in the menu right now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can open the user menu and modify the digital audio compression parameters.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Which specific submenu should I select?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Bradley, I have friends coming over in two hours for the Champions League match! Watching football with a two-second audio delay is completely unwatchable! It is infuriating to pay sixty pounds a month for a TV service that destroys the viewing experience!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand how deeply annoying and frustrating audio lip-sync delay is when watching football with friends, Leo. Let us adjust your box audio output format immediately to eliminate the processing buffer.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What setting should I change?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Open Settings on your TV box, navigate to 'Audio & Video', and select 'Digital Audio Output'.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Opened Digital Audio Output. It is currently set to 'Bitstream / Dolby Digital'.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Change that setting from 'Bitstream' to 'PCM Stereo'.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Changed to PCM Stereo... The sound dropped for half a second and returned... The lips and audio are slightly closer now, but it is still out of sync by half a second!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now navigate to 'Audio Delay Offset' and use the left arrow button to adjust the slider to minus one hundred milliseconds.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Moving slider to minus one hundred milliseconds... Bradley, it is still delayed! The commentators speak after the ball is kicked!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is the maximum manual audio offset range supported by the TVOS platform.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So the audio is still broken and out of sync for my match tonight?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You must wait for future firmware maintenance updates to address third-party optical timing.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is there really no other setting you can adjust from your central diagnostics panel?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Central diagnostics cannot alter the optical hardware buffer on local consumer electronics.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: This is so disappointing. I thought S-Net pride themselves on premium entertainment hardware.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our hardware is fully certified for direct HDMI connections to compatible high-definition television panels.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Most people route their television audio through dedicated speakers or soundbars rather than built-in TV panels.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our corporate audio certification list specifies which soundbar manufacturers have validated software drivers.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you lodge an official bug report with your TVOS engineering firmware development team?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can submit an engineering telemetry report to the audiovisual maintenance backlog.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please do so right now, and make sure to include the exact delay measurements I gave you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before I submit the engineering ticket, what was your TV set-top box model again?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: As I told you right at the start of our phone call, it is the 4K Pro Box.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have logged your audio delay feedback under engineering ticket reference AUD-88192-K.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: AUD-88192-K, noted down. But the issue is completely unresolved for tonight's game!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The ticket will be reviewed by our TV software engineering queue during regular development hours.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will have to mute the Sonos soundbar and listen through tinny TV speakers tonight. This is terrible service.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our TV platform engineering team deploys quarterly maintenance patches for digital audio decoders.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I hope the next quarterly patch actually resolves the optical lip-sync issue.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We cannot guarantee the inclusion of third-party audio driver patches in quarterly release schedules.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Understood. I will follow up if the next patch fails to fix it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there any other aspect of your TV service I can assist you with today, Leo?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, you have failed to resolve my problem.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net TV technical support, Leo. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye Bradley.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.
